claims.statement: The aggregated battery record identifies Samsung INR18650-25R as a flat-top, unprotected 18650 cell; blue and green wrapper revisions are known, so no single color is assigned.
Steam Engine preserves Samsung INR18650-25R 2500mAh 8.8C as a 2500mAh preset with a 8.8C runtime rating.
Battery Mooch assessed this tested exact model at 20A continuous discharge.
A peer-reviewed study characterizes the Samsung INR18650-25R positive electrode as a blend of NMC and NCA materials.
The exact catalog entry Samsung INR18650-25R has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2013-10 or earlier.

reviews.summary: Eligible Battery Mooch exact-model test conclusion retained with its original evidence date.
reservations: The conclusion applies to the tested sample and observable revision, not every later batch.

safetyFindings.summary: The runtime 8.8C value is 22A at 2500mAh, above the tested 20A CDR.
safetyFindings.runtimeImplication: Preserve compatibility value until separately approved; do not treat it as an endorsed CDR.
